policy-library: Layer 01 Govern-as-Code: a policy library of rules written as code under version control, each policy small, testable and tied to a commit, pull request or deploy.
crosswalks: Layer 01: the crosswalks that map each policy to the framework clauses it serves, generated from the code rather than maintained beside it.
registry: Layer 02 Inventory & Transparency: the agent registry, the runtime-aware inventory of every model, service and agent with an owner, a scope and a status, fed by the deploy pipeline.
aibom: Layer 02: the AIBOM, the bill of materials recording models, datasets, weights and their provenance, generated at build and stored with the registry entry.
eval-gate: Layer 03 Evals & Red Teaming as Evidence: the eval gate that runs the suites in CI and fails the build when a result drops below its agreed threshold.
eval-suites: Layer 03: the versioned eval suites (capability, adversarial and safety-threshold) whose structured results are filed against the registry entry as evidence.
guardrails: Layer 04 Runtime Controls & Observability: runtime guardrails that mediate tool calls and input/output, enforcing the scope the registry declares and streaming decisions and traces.
identity: Layer 04: each agent's own workload identity with a bounded scope and a tested kill switch that revokes access without breaking the fleet.
evidence-store: Layer 05 Assurance & Continuous Compliance: the assurance store that the lower layers write into and an auditor reads from, holding machine-readable OSCAL evidence so the audit is a query.
mappings: Layer 05: framework mappings generated from the evidence, so a mapping cell that turns green points at a control that actually fired.
